question: Four number-triads have been given, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the number-triad that is different from the rest.
solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic: The first two digits (unit and decimal) of the second number are the multiplication of the digits of the__ first number__. similarly, the last digit of the middle number is the multiplication of the digits of the __third number__.**

We will check each option:

 

**O**ption (1):

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/429656b7e516add29ae68fd1678c4058a9cf5e5558010237a55c6eb6d133cb2c.png] 

Here, the unit digit of the second number is the multiplication of the digits of the Third number and the last two digits of the second number are the multiplication of the digits of the First number. 

**Option (2): **

**Option (3):**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f865b36e7707e2aafe30b7b2d74f52548320a54d0eaf8d85610cc7ff87fe7403.png] 

**Option (4):**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/88f0717e7cea0b195e2096ffa7ce73e00bc1b3bd2528fed5c106f71cbc3eec80.png]
